Name: Ruka's Bachelors and Bachelorettes Portrait Mod
Author: klfion
Description:
This portrait mod currently only replaces the portraits of [b]bachelors[/b] and[b] bachelorettes[/b] and also includes their beach portraits. There may be a possible update for the rest of the villagers in the future!

★This mod will need [b]both[/b] SMAPI and Content Patcher to work!

Download the latest version for the most updated portraits!

[u]Install Instruction:
[/u][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿
[*]Unzip this mod folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Please let me know if there's any bug and I'll try my best to fix it asap :)

Downloads.Description: Replaces portraits of all marriage candidates and fixed a minor bug that was in v1.0.0!
